expires_today.title: Best of Synty Game Dev Assets Bundle 6
expires_today.description: Scene setting assets by Synty Studios
expires_today.long_description:
Game developers, rejoice! The pros at Synty Studios are back to help you take your project from concept to chart‑topping hit with our latest Software Bundle. Build your worlds with professional‑quality assets—we’re talking massive polygon prototype packs, particle FX packs, and Viking realms. Or add complex interfaces or simple shopping malls and stores—anything you need to help bring your dream game to life. You’ll even get a $10 voucher to the Synty Studios store to keep creating. Save big and do good for others by supporting Doctors Without Borders with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before October 31, 2027.

expires_today.title: Lovecraftian Horrors: STL Miniatures Mega Bundle by NSMiniatures
expires_today.long_description: Make your party and foes alike quake in fear at your gorgeously customized miniatures with the all‑new Lovecraftian Horrors: STL Miniatures Mega Bundle by NSMiniatures! Print your own witch‑blood‑drinking, Satan‑worshiping minis from the The Dunwich Horror - Miniatures + Props Collection, erect windowless crypts dripping with spirits of evil with the Cult of Nyarlathotep - Miniatures + Terrain Collection, and more with 15+ total packs to choose from. Add depth and darkness to your game night with fully customizable miniatures from the wizards at NSMiniatures, and help support Make‑A‑Wish with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Learn to Make Games in GODOT 2026
expires_today.description: Imagine your future as a game developer!
expires_today.long_description: Become a game dev mastermind when you harness the power of Godot! Learn how to create your own card battler from the ground up with compelling combo mechanics, develop your own community-forming fighter, build a fully-fledged farming game, and so much more with this curated bundle of approachable learning courses. Discover what’s possible the power of Godot to bring your dream game to life, all for a price you choose. Unlock the very best from Zenva and help support Alzheimer's Research UK with your purchase.

expires_today.title: The Almighty God Games Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
When life starts feeling out of control, play a game where you control everything! This unique bundle of simulation and strategy games lets you play God—literally—as you control what happens to whole worlds full of worshippers! Guide a civilization from humble beginnings to imperial galactic domination in The Universim! Create your own religion, convert your supplicants, and spread it across the land in Godhood! Or embody a sinister dark lord and bring the apocalypse to a fantasy realm in Shadows of Forbidden Gods! There are even more ways to rule the universe in this bundle of godlike games, so grab them now at the price of your choosing and support StackUp with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 12th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Backrooms and Liminal World Builder Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
Calling all prospective filmmakers! Create effortlessly with the Backrooms Pro Generator or the Procedural Backrooms Generator, with four architectural styles, customizable sliders, and no modeling required! Dress your corridors with 147 hand‑crafted vintage liminal props that make your project feel straight out of the 90s! Give your film the Kane Parsons treatment with his signature VHS/Handycam filter aesthetic. Whether you're chasing internet‑famous liminal‑space content, prototyping a horror game level, or just love the unsettling beauty of empty fluorescent‑lit rooms, this bundle is everything you need to start building your own Backrooms—no VFX studio required. Plus, your purchase helps support Trees, Water & People!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before February 28th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Legend In The Mist & :Otherscape RPG Collection by Son of Oak
expires_today.description: High fantasies, tech dystopias, and beyond
expires_today.long_description:
If you’ve been looking to expand your tabletop gaming horizons, look no further than this bundle of rulebooks, resource guides, and adventures set in two of the fantastical worlds of publisher Son of Oak! Brave the wilds of story-driven rustic fantasy TTRPG Legend in the Mist, an adventure steeped in folktales and magic! Or look to the future with cyberpunk fantasy Metro:Otherscape, where spirits and gods grant powers to tech-addled mortals! This bundle includes everything you need to start your campaign in either (or both!) RPG, from setting manuals to maps, character packs, soundtracks, and more! Dive into a new realm of adventure by grabbing this bundle at the price of your choice, and support the World Wildlife Fund with your purchase!

Codes are redeemable through the DriveThruRPG website.

expires_today.title: Ultimate Game Audio Bundle - Access 300,000 Premium Music and Sound Effects
expires_today.description: Thousands of audio assets at your fingertips
expires_today.long_description:
Create the perfect audioscape for your next game or creative project with a little help from the pros at Audio Hero. Jam out with 300,000 versatile assets from 100+ exclusive libraries for musicians, editors, sound designers, and audio pros of all levels. Explore a variety of music genres, voice packs, and game developer assets, from high-flyin’ rock instruments to dynamic explosion effects! With fully compatible Dolby Atmos collections inside, this bundle truly offers elite options for creatives. Unlock the rockstar-quality assets you need to nail the sound you’re looking for, and support Make-A-Wish with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: The Best of Brian W. Aldiss by Open Road Media
expires_tomorrow.description: Sci-fi like you’ve never seen it before
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Far off worlds! Dangerous Edens! The future of humanity and beyond! Read the works of a true master of science fiction with this massive bundle of ebooks by Brian W. Aldiss! Visit a planet with seasons that last for centuries and civilizations in constant conflict in Helliconia Spring! Discover the secrets behind a mad scientist’s beastly creations in An Island Called Moreau! Follow a utopian Mars colony as they fight to survive against insurmountable odds in Finches of Mars! All of these adventures and more are included in this bundle of over 40 fantastic ebooks by a true master of the genre. Get them now at the price of your choosing, and support Active Minds charity with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Kurt Busiek's Astro City: The 30th Anniversary by Image Comics
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Celebrate multi‑time Eisner and Harvey Award winner author Kurt Busiek’s most popular works with The 30th Anniversary Bundle by Image Comics! Lose yourself in the complete Astro City series! How do average people, support teams, and even villains navigate day‑to‑day life in a world where being truly super is possible—read volumes 1‑17 and see what makes Astro City so unforgettable. Or explore The Autumnlands, an epic tale that melds mature themes with high‑fantasy wizardry! Pay what you want for critically acclaimed comics and help support The BINC Foundation with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Animate Like a Pro with Moho PRO
expires_tomorrow.description: Elite animations for professionals and digital artists
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Animate like a pro—MOHO Pro 12.5 offers powerful rigging tools or 2D projects, assistance on frame-by-frame animation, dynamic particles and physics effects, and so much more! Don’t wait, Humble members who purchase this bundle receive a $125 credit towards an upgrade to MOHO Pro 14! Pay what you want for amazing creation tools, and help support Child’s Play Charity with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: Joe Haldeman: The Forever War and Beyond by Open Road Media
expires_within_72h.description: The future worlds of Joe Haldeman
expires_within_72h.long_description: Meet one of the masters of science fiction in this collection of books by the one and only Joe Haldeman! See where it all started with his Nebula, Hugo, and Locus Award winning novel The Forever War, a drama of civilizations trapped in interstellar conflict! Embark on a nailbiting trip to the surface of a future Earth threatened by a terrorist plot in Worlds! Follow an intergalactic spy wracked with guilt over dangerous missions in All My Sins Remembered! There’s even more to explore in this bundle of 17 of Joe Haldeman’s greatest sci-fi stories, so grab them now at the price of your choice and support Active Minds charity with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: Trineverse Triple Co-Op Pack
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Step into a fantasy world where magic and mystery are around every corner and nothing is as it seems. Might as well invite a few friends along for the ride! Send your wizard, your thief, and your knight out into the dangerous kingdom at the heart of the Trine series, where you can battle enemies, solve mysterious puzzles, and find out the truth of this forsaken realm. In this very special Trine bundle, we’re offering the first four Trine games plus Nine Parchments for $10!

Since these games are better with a crowd, you can get two copies of every game for $14, or three copies for $18 to play in co-op mode with your friends! You choose how you make your way through the world of Trine, and support Trees, Water & People with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 14th, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: Bundle - Indie Fears
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Get into the spooky season with this new bundle of the creepiest indie games around! Discover what all the fuss is about with the much-memed space-set nightmare fuel game Mouthwashing. Keep a mystery train running and try not to run out of oxygen on the steep mountain slopes of Threshold. Flip burgers and keep your customers satisfied in the spooky cooking simulator send-up Kiosk. Those aren’t even the tip of the horror game iceberg featured in this bundle, so name your price and help support the Prevent Cancer Foundation charity with your purchase. And maybe keep a light on while you play. You never know.
